description: This file defines custom formatters for PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) data structures used in 5G NR (New Radio) physical layer processing, including formatters for codeword descriptions and PDU (Protocol Data Unit) structures.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::pdsch_processor::codeword_description>
classes.description: Custom formatter for codeword_description, formats modulation and redundancy version.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::pdsch_processor::pdu_t>
classes.description: Custom formatter for pdu_t, formats various PDSCH PDU fields including RNTI, resource block allocation, symbols, codewords, and other protocol-specific parameters.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for the formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the data structure into a string representation.
